items.text:
I would give this game a 7/10
Mechanically its clunky and full of bugs. 
lots of things that could be done but are not, a lot of things implemented but not fully or well.

but the game is fun and should be given a try. just overlook the character creation settings from the DEI era. they are optional so play no real part in the game.
items.text_zh:
我会给这款游戏打7/10分
机制上它很笨拙，而且满是bug。
有很多事情本可以做却没有做，有很多东西实现了但没有完全实现或实现得好。

但这款游戏很有趣，应该试一试。只要忽略DEI时代的角色创建设置就行。它们是可选的，所以在游戏中没有真正的作用。
